constraints.name: bending stiffness
constraints.text: bending stiffness relaxed by the user on 2026-11-21 to 40 N/mm (cantilever, 100 N tip load along z: tip deflection <= 2.5 mm); originally 50 N/mm (2 mm), unreachable with the catalogs (study 11-20-26 boom_1m_comp100N_k50_tors1deg10Nmm_hub50)

constraints.name: buckling
constraints.text: 100 N under compression buckling load pin-pin

constraints.name: torsional stiffness
constraints.text: torsional stiffness such that it will not rotate more than 1 degrees under 10 Nmm torque

constraints.name: no failure under the torque
constraints.text: Hashin F < 1 under the 10 N mm torque (study step loadcases)

constraints.name: no failure: axial100N
constraints.text: ensure to check no material failure throughout the simulation runs: Hashin F < 1 under a 100 N axial compression tip load, linear, cantilever (interpreted as in the 11-19-26 study)

constraints.text: coil on 50 mm hub (taken as the hub RADIUS, as the user answered for the 11-19-26 study)
